answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 165 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sable account. Deposits are visible in anchor, and whisper reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 17% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 54 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
